description: zachthedev/.github: the reusable workflows and the preset. The image pins below exist only here, because the workflows that carry them live only here.

The Renovate image is looked up on Docker Hub, the one registry whose tags carry a release timestamp, and pulled from ghcr.io by the same digest. The action reads renovate-version natively as ghcr.io/renovatebot/renovate, which has no timestamp and would hold forever, so that dependency is disabled and the regex manager owns the pin.

packageRules.description: Callers run these workflows at a release of this repository, so a pin inside one ships to them and cuts a release. .github's own ci.yml, cd.yml and audit.yml stay ci.

typescript is held on the last major carrying the JavaScript compiler API, below the first release typescript-eslint's typescript peer range excludes, because typescript-eslint reads types through that API and the native compiler lacks it. This rule and the @typescript/native alias go once typescript-eslint supports the native compiler: https://typescript-eslint.io/users/dependency-versions
One pull request whatever the bump size: the action, the image it runs and the npm package whose validator the gate runs carry the same release line.
